products.name: HireVue
products.note: Video interviewing AI; facial analysis controversy; algorithmic hiring bias; regulatory scrutiny

profile_text.body:
HireVue is a for-profit company founded in 2004 and headquartered in South Jordan, Utah. The company describes itself as offering AI-powered video interviewing, skills assessments, and candidate evaluation tools aimed at helping employers validate candidate skills and competencies. It markets its platform particularly toward recruiting early talent and recent graduates, positioning automated video interviews and AI-driven assessments as a way to identify candidates without requiring on-campus recruiting visits.

The company's flagship product, also called HireVue, is categorized as an HR and Talent AI tool and has attracted notable scrutiny over its use of facial analysis in hiring decisions, concerns about algorithmic bias, and regulatory attention. The company carries significant legal exposure in Utah, with 32 associated legal matters recorded there, and is also named in a federal case, Rodrigues v. HireVue, Inc., filed in the District Court for the Western District of Missouri.
